profile.headline: Cybersecurity Admin / Software Engineer / 3D Designer / Additive Manufacture
profile.summary:
COMPUTER PROGRAMMER - As a Purdue University Global graduate and programming enthusiast, I desire to utilize my deep passion for software development. While earning my BS in Cyber Security I built a home lab to apply what I was learning to test my innovative ideas in software development. One test resulted in successfully creating software to evaluate detailed market analysis and automate trades for Crypto, Forex, and Stocks. 

INTERESTS 
PROGRAMMING - Developed several Trading algorithms for Crypto, Forex, and Stocks utilizing Python, MQL4, and MQL5 which provided accurate realization of market flow and reliability or lack thereof.
PROGRAMMING - Created and published Android applications in Kotlin and Java
PROGRAMMING - Created script in Python to mimic user input to create and schedule 24 months of weekly livestreams reducing the task completion time by 99%. 
PROGRAMMING - Automated the weekly church website updates using JavaScript (Dynamic Links JS), eliminating the need for manual updates.
PROGRAMMING - Built MeritTracker database utilizing VBA and Excel to track boys’ advancements within Royal Rangers Outposts.   
CYBERSECURITY - Performs routine hardware and software maintenance for optimized and secure use of technical equipment 
AV TECH - Manages weekly live streams to optimize the remote experience.
